name: lecturelens
description: Web-based lesson library: plain-language study notes generated from slides/PDFs by Claude Code, read and managed by a Next.js app in a code-editor-style viewer.
purpose: Notes are written in plain high-school-level language with technically correct terminology (Information Systems & Network Engineering program). Content creation happens entirely outside the web application — Claude Code is the sole author; the Next.js app is the reader/manager.
principles: Two-layer contract: Next.js reads and manages, the Go helper (vaultd) is dumb filesystem I/O.
Claude Code is the author but is not a layer inside the app.
No naming/slug/sequence logic in vaultd — that is Next.js's job.
No filesystem writes from a React component or API route directly — always through lib/vault/helper.ts -> vaultd.
No AI generation logic or Anthropic API calls in the Next.js app itself; two sanctioned delegations exist (chat proxy, generation job runner).
No chunking/embedding/ranking logic in vaultd or Next.js — that intelligence lives only in indexd.
No business logic in the desktop shell (Tauri) — only start/stop orchestration.

webapp.role: UI, routing, API proxying, vault management (create/rename/delete/list)

delegations.name: Generate from file
delegations.mechanism: spawns local Claude Code CLI headlessly (-p, --output-format stream-json)

vaultd.role: filesystem CRUD only, zero business logic

indexd.role: search/RAG backend only — chunking, embedding, hybrid retrieval
indexd.storage: vault/.index/index.db (SQLite: metadata + FTS5 + embedding BLOBs, derived/safe to delete)

desktop.role: Tauri shell: orchestration only, no business logic
desktop.vaultLocation: checkout's vault/, baked in at compile time (single-vault, checkout-centric design)

local-desktop.description: Tauri native window, single machine, single vault
local-desktop.command: npm run dev:desktop | npm run build:desktop

local-browser.description: plain Next.js dev/prod server on the writer machine, full read/write + generation
local-browser.command: npm run dev | npm run build && npm run start

remote-reader.description: read-only instance for other devices (iPad/laptop); generation and folder/lesson mutation disabled at middleware.ts, gated by READ_ONLY/NEXT_PUBLIC_READ_ONLY
requires: vaultd/indexd reachable from the reader instance (shared filesystem sync or a tunnel + VAULTD_TOKEN/INDEXD_TOKEN)
remote-reader.command: READ_ONLY=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_READ_ONLY=1 npm run build && npm run start
remote-reader.recommendedTunnel: Cloudflare Tunnel (free) + Cloudflare Access in front of vaultd/indexd public hostnames
cannotRunRemotely: /api/generate (requires local claude CLI + subscription auth on the writer machine only)

techStack.searchRag: Go HTTP service (indexd) + SQLite (FTS5 + vector BLOBs)
techStack.auth: none for the app itself; optional shared-secret header (X-Auth-Token) between Next.js and vaultd/indexd when exposed remotely

outOfScope: No database as source of truth
No user authentication of any kind
No AI generation logic inside the application itself
No hosting/deployment pipeline beyond what's documented in README.md
